+        f"Widget maxlength should be '{expected_max_length}', got '{username_field.widget.attrs['maxlength']}'"

+    )
+    django.setup()
+
+from django.contrib.auth.forms import AuthenticationForm
+from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
+
+def test_maxlength_attribute():
+    """Test that the username field has maxlength HTML attribute."""
+    form = AuthenticationForm()
+    username_field = form.fields['username']
+    
+    # Get the User model to check expected max_length

+

+        f"Field max_length should be {expected_max_length}, got {username_field.max_length}"
+    
+    # Check that widget attrs include maxlength
+    assert 'maxlength' in username_field.widget.attrs, \
+        "Widget attrs should include 'maxlength'"
+    
+    assert username_field.widget.attrs['maxlength'] == str(expected_max_length), \
+        f"Widget maxlength should be '{expected_max_length}', got '{username_field.widget.attrs['maxlength']}'"
+    
+    # Check that rendered HTML includes maxlength attribute
+    html = str(form['username'])
+    assert 'maxlength' in html, \
+        "Rendered HTML should include maxlength attribute"
+    
+    assert f'maxlength="{expected_max_length}"' in html, \
+        f"Rendered HTML should include maxlength=\"{expected_max_length}\""
